field_rationale.empty_probe: Capacity zero is stored unchanged. At empty occupancy zero meets zero. With capacity five the level branch distinguishes DEBUG from the inclusive WARNING boundary.
field_rationale.capacity_zero: Appending the low record leaves occupancy greater than zero and dispatches that record immediately.
field_rationale.custom_level: With capacity five the first low record stays buffered. The next record matches flushLevel and triggers delivery of the entire pair.

field_rationale.disabled: The target reference is installed. Its Boolean conversion is false, so the high-level and explicit flush attempts leave a buffered.
field_rationale.enabled: The same target object becomes truthy. The next explicit flush sends the retained record and clears it.
field_rationale.final: With target None, b remains pending. Reinstalling t only changes the pointer; c then reaches capacity, so b and c join a at the sink in that order.

Invoke filters in order; false vetoes, a LogRecord replaces the current record, and the final record is returned.

field_rationale.target_filters: MemoryHandler uses target.handle for each queued record. Target filters run in registration order; the second filter sees x for a and b for b.
field_rationale.source_returns: The source inherited handle returns its own accepted record in each case. Target return values do not influence the source result.
field_rationale.final: The direct target handler call does not compare handler level. Its two filters accept x and veto b. Returning False does not interrupt flush or prevent the clear.

field_rationale.close_and_old_sink: Default close attempts delivery. The sink gets a and raises on b. MemoryHandler does not call the old sink’s flush or close. The exception propagates after cleanup.
field_rationale.after_close: The finally clause clears the target. The parent’s dynamically dispatched flush now has no target; the failed first loop never cleared the original batch.
field_rationale.recovery: Retargeting and flushing use the retained batch despite the close. Both entries reach the new sink and the buffer clears.

field_rationale.before: All three inputs stay below capacity and flush level; no target emission occurs before the explicit flush.
field_rationale.events: The loop reads self.target anew for each call. First.emit sets a different target during delivery of a. The reentrant lock permits that public setter on this thread; b and c reach second.
field_rationale.after: Normal loop completion clears the buffer and does not change the newly installed target. Each sink retains only its own received records.

field_rationale.second_call: The source filter raises while inherited handle is selecting the record, before emit. No handler code catches the exception.
field_rationale.after_handle: The source filter has seen both a and b. Only a was appended; the unsuccessful second handle never triggers a flush.
field_rationale.after_emit: Direct emit bypasses the raising filter. It appends b and the inclusive ERROR trigger flushes the two records to the sink.
